title: hotfix: enforce SLO-based circuit breakers + regional failover load-shedding (critical incident mitigation)
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: during the 2026-02-16 partial regional outage we observed that overloaded regional pools were accepting requests beyond configured SLO thresholds which cascaded into increased p99 latency and customer-facing errors. This hotfix enforces SLO-aware circuit breakers and improves regional failover load-shedding to reduce blast radius. Changes include: 1) SLO enforcement path in runtime enforcer to track per-route p95/p99 and trip circuit breakers when sustained SLO violations occur; 2) deterministic load-shedding policy for regional failover that prefers routing to compatible model variants and throttles low-priority traffic; 3) faster open->half-open backoff with jitter and improved health probes to avoid repeated noisy retries; 4) telemetry improvements to expose circuit state, shed decisions, and SLO windows to Console dashboards. This PR is intended as a hotfix and should be backported to release/2026-02 within the next 24h. Testing: unit tests for breaker logic, integration test harness replaying incident traffic, canary rollout to 10% traffic in us-west-2, and manual failover drills. Rollout plan: merge to main -> automatic canary -> monitor SLOs for 2 hours -> full rollout. Risk: changes touch routing and runtime decision paths; mitigations include conservative default thresholds and kill-switch feature flag. Related: ENG-4123 (incident remediation), ENG-4210 (regional failover design).
commits: 4 commits: 1) enforce: add SLO window tracking and breaker trigger logic; 2) perf: improve shed policy and scoring for regional routing; 3) infra: add feature flag and terraform toggle for canary; 4) observability: emit circuit_breaker.{state,reason,window} metrics
changed_files: runtime/slo/enforcer.go, runtime/circuit/circuit_breaker.go, routing/regional_failover.go, routing/load_shed_policy.go, observability/metrics/circuit_exporter.go, infra/terraform/feature_flags.tf, tests/integration/incident_replay_test.go, tests/unit/circuit_breaker_test.go, docs/ops/runbooks/regional-failover.md

Diego: asked for a canary rollback plan and added a kill-switch flag; confirmed with infra that terraform toggle exists. Maya: ran local canary and observed correct shed decisions; approved. release_notes:
- Hotfix: enforce SLO-based circuit breakers to automatically open in sustained p95/p99 violations
- Hotfix: deterministic regional failover load-shedding that throttles low-priority traffic and routes to compatible model variants
- Telemetry: new metrics for circuit breaker state and shed decisions added to Console
notes_for_oncall: Deployment includes a kill-switch feature flag (runtime.breaker.disable=false by default). If unexpected increased 5xxs or massive request drops occur, flip runtime.breaker.disable=true to immediately disable new breaker trips and rollback canary via infra toggle. Monitor metrics: circuit_breaker.open_count, shed.decisions, route.slo.p99; expected temporary reduction in throughput during canary as low-priority requests are shed.
backport_instructions: Cherry-pick the squash commit into release/2026-02 and run the same canary sequence. Ensure infra/terraform/feature_flags.tf is applied in the release environment before traffic cutover.
